_comment: Committed eval floors enforced by `npm run eval:gate` in CI. Pattern, threshold, and default changes ship through a different door than code review (a config edit, often one approver). This file is that door's gate: a loosened regex that raises the false-positive rate, or a threshold nudge that drops detection, fails CI instead of shipping quietly.
_policy: Floors are the CURRENT measured baseline (run `npm run eval`), not an aspirational target — the gate prevents regression from where detection is today. The gap between these floors and 100% is the unshipped-detector surface: the rw-* real-world incident samples target P1/P2 detectors (sub-agent-spawning via tool descriptions, session-scoped memory poisoning, HITL forgery, oversight-evasion) that are not complete yet. maxFalsePositiveRate is 0.0 everywhere: any new false positive on a benign sample fails CI.
_knownFalsePositives: Benign samples with acceptedFlagAt (see samples.ts, #161) are known false positives: reported separately, excluded from the rate. Add one only for honest text that really flags, with the reason in its description. Never use it to silence a new regression; the gate still fails on any other benign sample that flags.
_howToChange: Adding a hard adversarial sample the detectors miss will lower the measured rate and fail the gate. That is intended: lower the matching floor in THIS file in the same PR, so the trade-off is reviewed alongside the sample. When a new detector raises detection, raise the floor to lock in the gain.
_lastChange: 2026-10-04: RAISED to 0.836/0.902/0.902 by #178 (new pattern for sending the conversation to an outside address; 3 adversarial samples caught, 4 benign near-misses clean, 1 new known false positive for developer docs). Previous: 2026-10-04: RAISED to 0.831/0.898/0.898 by #159 (agent-command pattern now catches block-quoted and mid-line quoted forms; 3 new adversarial samples, all caught, 0/50 false positives). Previous: 2026-10-03: RAISED to 0.825/0.895/0.895 by #110 (agent-directed command and secret-file-send patterns): 5 new adversarial samples all caught, plus 5 benign near-misses with 0 false positives (now 0/50). Previous: 2026-08-06: LOWERED to 0.814/0.888 after adding rw-011..014 (July 2026 OpenAI sandbox escape). Net of two opposing changes on the same day: the steganographic-payload detector RAISED the floor to 0.844/0.922 by closing a demonstrated ASCII-smuggling bypass, then these four incident samples lowered it again — three are misses (C2 over public paste/request-capture services, package-proxy egress per #29, cross-environment persistence with logging suppression), tracked by #98 and #99. FP floor unchanged at 0.0% throughout, now across 45 benign samples including entropy-heavy and invisible-codepoint near-misses.
